situation: A family planning a visit to the Eden Project.
topic: How much is an adult day ticket at the Eden Project, and is it open in December?

text: Right so the eden project, does anyone know if it's open in december and how much an adult day ticket is? Want to plan the day out 🌱
idk!! haven't been since year 8 🙈 i think it's open most of the year??
No idea love. What's the day, saturday?
@claude what's the adult day ticket price at the eden project and are they open in december? 🌱

The Eden Project's booking page doesn't show a plain adult day ticket price. It lists a general adult ticket (valid for a year) at £35.50 online or £39.50 on the door. Eden also runs Christmas events from 20 Nov to 2 Jan, so it looks open in December. The page doesn't give daily hours, so check those before you go: https://edenproject.com/visit/opening-times

@claude is the eden christmas light thing on sat 12th or only certain nights

Yes, Sat 12th is a lights night. Eden's page lists the lights on 3–6, 10–23 and 26–31 December, so it's not every night. Day visitors' Biomes close at 3.15pm. The evening lights session runs 4pm to 8.30pm and seems to be for Christmas Lights Pass holders, so check which ticket you need.

https://www.edenproject.com/visit/whats-on/christmas-at-the-eden-project

@claude how much is the eden christmas lights pass and does it cover the 12th 🙈

The Christmas Lights Pass is £12.50 for adults (16+), and under-16s go free. It covers Sat 12th, because the lights run 10–23 December. You'd also need a normal Eden admission ticket, though some ticket types already include the Lights. Pass holders can enter from 4pm to 8.30pm.

https://www.edenproject.com/visit/whats-on/christmas-at-the-eden-project
